text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I made it all the way to the end, 
Trainer! The divine blessing worked like a 
charm—great fortune in contests~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I felt like I saw a path of light 
across the turf, barking, "Go through 
here, woof!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Since I've made my debut... that means the 
road ahead keeps going, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Well then, please choose our 
next race... is what I'd like to say, but.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Why not take a leap of faith and leave it 
to fortune-telling?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! After all, you know, this 
kind of thing is pretty much my real 
charm~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well then, here goes! Go ahead and draw 
your Next Race Fortune! What you get is 
totally up to luck!
Target race changed to the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's the Yayoi Sho! Nakayama 2000m in the 
spring, push through the grass and trees, 
bloom proud, maiden~!
Target race changed to the Spring Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's the Spring Stakes! 1800 meters at 
Nakayama, who will don the crown of fresh 
sprouts—?!

The target race has been set to the 
Mainichi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's the Mainichi Hai! 1,800 meters on the 
Hanshin track, an unpretentious GIII. The 
true value of daily diligence will be put 
to the test!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go with that! Hehehe, now 
I'm really getting hyped up!
choice_data_list: Feels like you're phoning it in...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I wasn't just phoning it in~~~! It's not 
being lazy, it's, you know, THAT!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's ju~st as the gods have spoken. After 
all, you're the one who drew it, 
Trainer-san♪
